newsitem.title: USA: Northeast U.S. temperatures seen normal next week.
newsitem.headline: Northeast U.S. temperatures seen normal next week.

text.p: The cold spell in the northeastern United States should end by Friday with near to slightly above normal temperatures expected to hit the region by next week, said Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis.
The cold spell will cause above average heating requirements which should decrease to more normal levels by this weekend and early next week, Davis said.
Davis forecasted temperatures 11 to 15 degrees below normal through Friday in the Northeast.
He expects temperatures in the Midwest to average 12 to 17 degrees below normal through Thursday.
Davis forecasted a moderating trend by Friday for the Midwest, bringing normal temperatures this weekend into next week.
